PURPOSE: Identify and document candidate Monotributo threshold-change episodes for LAB-HYP-0006, using already-admitted sources first, and rule on episode selection. Does NOT compute any causal effect, adjudicate LAB-HYP-0006, or close LAB-Q-0013 empirically.

LAB_Q_0013.TEXT: Does a change in Monotributo tax-category thresholds have a causal effect on the observed shift between EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP and MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION?
IDENTIFICATION_REQUIREMENTS: A documented threshold-change event with a plausible discontinuity design

LAB_HYP_0006.TREATMENT: A Monotributo tax-category threshold change (a specific, dated episode)
LAB_HYP_0006.OUTCOME: Rate of transition between EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP (LAB-OBJ-0003) and MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION (LAB-OBJ-0016)
LAB_HYP_0006.POPULATION: Persons near a Monotributo tax-category threshold
LAB_HYP_0006.METRIC: Discontinuity in the rate of transition between EMPLOYMENT_RELATIONSHIP and MONOTRIBUTO_REGISTRATION around the threshold-change date
LAB_HYP_0006.OPERATIONAL_DEFINITION: Candidate regression-discontinuity-style design around a specific, not-yet-selected threshold-change event; not implemented
LAB_HYP_0006.EXPECTED_OBSERVATION: A detectable discontinuity in transition rates coincident with the threshold change
LAB_HYP_0006.FAILURE_CONDITION: No detectable discontinuity around the threshold-change date
LAB_HYP_0006.CAUSAL_DESIGN: Regression-discontinuity-in-time around a specific policy date
